name: Autoscience
insight: Its AI agent Carl produced the first fully AI-generated paper to pass double-blind academic peer review.
tagline: Autonomous AI research lab whose agents run experiments end-to-end.
description: Autoscience is an applied research lab building a virtual laboratory of autonomous AI scientists that generate hypotheses, design and run machine-learning experiments, and write up the results. Its agent Carl authored a full-length paper that passed double-blind peer review with only minor human edits. The San Mateo company raised a $14M seed round in March 2026 led by General Catalyst.

modelSupport.notes: Autonomous research agents run the experiment loop; not a model you bring keys to.

edge: Its agents run the whole research loop end-to-end — hypothesis, experiments, and write-up — rather than just assisting a human researcher.
pros: Full experiment loop, not just ideation
Generates and tests its own hypotheses
cons: Scope so far is ML research papers
